description: In the world of the Noblesses, Lavinia wove her web ever larger, wielding greater and greater influence. The few people that knew her, feared her and thought she was untouchable... The day of her birthday, when the Pisces constellation lit up the sky, a single drop of dark water fell upon her out of a cloudless sky. Soon her spies had no more orders, and many wars were avoided. The Corruption respects neither rank, nor power.
summon: Nothing can stop the Corruption, it will go on spreading...
fusion: I can feel my grip on desolation increasing.
